newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-THUNDERSTORMS WIPE OUT NEW ORLEANS THIRD ROUND.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-THUNDERSTORMS WIPE OUT NEW ORLEANS THIRD ROUND.

text.p: Severe thunderstorms delayed the start of the third round of the Freeport-McDermott Classic and prevented the field from completing the round.
All 71 players who made the cut will resume play in the third round Sunday morning and then play the final round Sunday afternoon.

The leaders had competed just eight holes when play was called for darkness. Larry Rinker held a one-stroke lead at 12 under par through eight. His playing partners Scott McCarron and Brad Faxon were the only other players in double digits under par. McCarron, the defending champion was at 11 under, while Faxon was 10 under par.
Kirk Triplett was in fourth place at nine under through nine holes.
Spain's Jose Maria Olazabal was in fifth place at eight under through nine holes, but said that he was very concerned about playing 27 holes on Sunday.

Olazabal has just returned from an 18-month absence from golf because of foot problems, still walks with a limp, and has not played more than 18 holes in a day since his feet started paining him two years ago.
